t: Where can you buy DVDs and Blu-rays? | Diverse Tech Geek
s: September 1, 2024 - Gruv is an online store jointly run by Warner Bros. and Universal, selling DVDs and Blu-rays of both studios’ libraries. Frequently there’s various sales and discounts, some tied into major holidays (horror films on sale during October, for instance). However, default shipping is a bit slower than through, say, Amazon. I’ve used Gruv to buy films and TV shows ranging from the 90s-era Batman movies (as a cheap single Blu-ray set) to the late 60s Hanna-Barbera cartoon “Wacky Races.”
